description: The workflow contract for any agent that ingests, retrieves from, or maintains a claude-wiki-pages vault. Documents the safe ordering — ground → judge → verify — checkpoint discipline, retrieval grounding, and the immutability rules, so an external agent can drive the wiki correctly without re-reading the whole spec. Trigger when an agent or user asks "how should I maintain the wiki", "what is the safe ingest/retrieve order", "how do other agents use this", or invokes /claude-wiki-pages:maintain-contract. Reference, not action.
